title: File:Joysagar.jpg
author: Supratim Deka Narakasura
description: View of Joysagar lake in w:Sibsagar town in w:Assam, India. This large man made lake was built in honor of Joymoti, by her son Ahom king Rudra Singha. The buildings housing the Sibsagar College are seen along the banks in the distance. Also visible along the horizon are the hills of neighbouring w:Nagaland.
period_note: Later Ahom-period tank / present-day landscape; specific features need dating
